title: GO:1905523 · Random: score distributions
caption: Distribution of test-set scores for positives and negatives, GO:1905523 random split. The vertical line is the default decision threshold. SVM (RBF) on Conjoint triad: median score 0.94 for positives against -0.84 for negatives; Logistic regression on k-sep. bigram PSSM: median score 0.98 for positives against 0.01 for negatives. Overlap between the two histograms is what limits AUROC, whatever the threshold.
